question: What are the top 3 products by total revenue?
sql_generated:
SELECT 
    items.title AS product_name,
    items.dept AS product_category,
    SUM(basket_items.amount) AS total_revenue
FROM 
    basket_items
JOIN 
    items ON basket_items.item_id = items.item_id
GROUP BY 
    items.title
ORDER BY 
    total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 3
